tests: Frame with EtherType=0x88A4 + EtherCAT header Type=0x1 + valid datagrams is accepted; ESC forwards on-the-fly.
Frame with wrong EtherType (e.g. 0x88A5) is forwarded transparently; no datagram processing.
Frame with EtherCAT header Type=0x4 (Network Variables — EAP) is forwarded but not processed by ESC.
Frame with Length field exceeding 1486 B is rejected (datagram block truncated).
Frame shorter than 60 B is padded by the MAC; ESC operates on the padded frame correctly.
Frame with FCS error: ESC increments Frame Error Counter (0x0300); frame is still forwarded (data integrity is per-datagram via WKC).
NOP (0x00): no SubDevice modifies the frame; WKC unchanged.
APRD (0x01) with Position == 0: addressed SubDevice reads, +1 WKC; the SubDevice increments Position before forwarding.
APRW (0x03): atomic read-then-write; +3 WKC.
FPRD (0x04) targeting Configured Station Address == this SubDevice: +1 WKC.
FPRD targeting a different address: +0 WKC, frame forwarded unchanged.
BRD (0x07): every SubDevice increments WKC by 1; total WKC == number of SubDevices.
BWR (0x08) clearing all Frame Error Counters: every counter at 0 after exchange.
LRD (0x0A) with FMMU mapping: addressed SubDevices read; WKC matches expected.
LWR (0x0B) with overlapping FMMU mappings: multiple SubDevices write to same logical region; deterministic union by bit position.
LRW (0x0C): combined read + write in one datagram; WKC = +3 per successful SubDevice.
ARMW (0x0D): first matching SubDevice writes data into frame; subsequent SubDevices read it (used for DC propagation).
Power-up: SubDevice is in Init; AL Status = 0x01.
Init → PreOp: MainDevice writes AL Control (0x0120) = 0x02; SubDevice configures mailbox SMs; AL Status = 0x02.
PreOp → SafeOp: MainDevice writes AL Control = 0x04; SubDevice validates SM2/SM3/FMMU; if invalid → AL Status = 0x14 (PreOp + Error) + AL Status Code (e.g. 0x001E 'Invalid Input Configuration').
SafeOp → Op: MainDevice writes AL Control = 0x08; SubDevice arms PD WD; AL Status = 0x08.
Op → SafeOp: MainDevice writes AL Control = 0x04 OR PD WD expiry; AL Status = 0x14.
Init → Boot: MainDevice writes AL Control = 0x03; AL Status = 0x03; only FoE valid.
Illegal transition (e.g. Init → Op directly): SubDevice rejects with AL Status = 0x11 (Init + Error) + AL Status Code 0x0011 'Invalid requested state change'.
FMMU entry with Active=0 ignored.
FMMU entry with Logical_Start_Address + Length covering a logical region: LRD/LWR datagrams targeting that region read/write the mapped physical address.
Bit-granular FMMU: Logical_Start_Bit + Logical_Stop_Bit map to a sub-byte slice; only those bits are read/written, neighbour bits preserved.
Two FMMUs with overlapping logical regions: read FMMU + write FMMU on same region allows LRW one-datagram I/O.
SM0 Mailbox-Out (Read direction from PDI): handshake — PDI signals ready after reading; subsequent MainDevice FPWR overwrites.

SM2/SM3 Process Data 3-buffer mode: ECAT writes buffer A; PDI reads buffer A (now buffer B becomes 'last-written'); ECAT writes buffer B; ...; overrun protection prevents PDI from reading half-written buffer.
SM Watchdog Trigger bit 6 in Control: write triggers the PD WD; missing writes → PD WD expiry → Op → SafeOp.
BWR to 0x0900 latches RX timestamps on every port of every DC-capable SubDevice; subsequent FPRD reads return non-zero values.
Propagation delay measurement: MainDevice reads (T_RX_port1 - T_RX_port0) per SubDevice; sum from MainDevice equals cumulative cable + ESC forwarding delay.
System Time Offset (0x0920) written by MainDevice: SubDevice's local System Time (0x0910) matches reference within drift.
Cyclic ARMW propagates reference System Time: SubDevices' 0x0910 stays within ±100 ns of reference.

SYNC0 pulse generation: writing Cyclic Unit Control + Activation + Sync0 Cycle Time → SubDevice generates output pulses with the programmed period; jitter measured by oscilloscope < 100 ns across hops.
CoE SDO Upload (FC 0x40-0x4F): MainDevice requests Object Dictionary entry 0x1018:1 (Vendor ID); SubDevice returns 4-byte value.
CoE SDO Download: MainDevice writes 0x1C12:1 (RxPDO Mapping); SubDevice returns success.
CoE Emergency: SubDevice posts Emergency message on SM1; MainDevice reads.
FoE WRQ / DATA / ACK firmware download in Boot state.
EoE: SubDevice tunnels ICMP Echo Request through mailbox; MainDevice forwards to standard NIC; ICMP Echo Reply tunneled back.
Datagram targeting N SubDevices returns WKC = N (BRD) or appropriate per-cmd increment.
Cable break between SubDevice k and k+1: subsequent cyclic frame's WKC drops by (N - k); MainDevice diagnoses missing SubDevices.
External diagnostic tool sends FPRD 0x0130 sweep through MainDevice's pass-through interface; receives AL Status of every SubDevice without disturbing cyclic exchange.
External diagnostic tool reads RX Error Counters (0x0300-0x030F); cyclic frame error rate quantified.

conformance_test_tool_categories: ETG.1500 Conformance Test (CT) suite from the EtherCAT Technology Group covers all of the above. Pass is required before commercial release of a certified EtherCAT product. CT runs the ESC through every register access, ESM transition, mailbox protocol, FMMU/SM configuration, and DC compatibility scenario.
notes: Wireshark with the EtherCAT dissector + a passive Ethernet tap is the standard hand-debug setup. Frame-level capture lets engineers verify Cmd field, Address, Length, IRQ, WKC, and the mailbox payload byte-by-byte.
